content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-explained-digital-creators-stripe-2|stripe]]'s availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-which-architecture-actually-2|Payment Gateways]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-5|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stripe alternatives

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a set of tools and platforms that allow digital creators to build and manage their own online stores, without relying on third-party services. This approach provides creators with full ownership and control over their commerce stack, enabling them to operate independently and make decisions about their business without external interference. By using open-source technologies and decentralized payment systems, creators can ensure that their businesses are resilient and adaptable to changing market conditions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure is based on a combination of open-source technologies, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and decentralized payment systems like NOWPayments. These components work together to provide a seamless and secure payment processing experience for customers. By using automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, creators can ensure that transactions are processed quickly and efficiently, without the need for intermediaries.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators who are excluded from traditional payment processing systems, such as those in Nigeria. These creators need a reliable and secure way to sell their digital products globally, without being restricted by geographical or financial limitations. By providing a decentralized and open-source solution, sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to take control of their businesses and reach a wider audience.
Empower your digital business with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, decentralized payment systems like NOWPayments, and order storage solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets. These components work together to provide a comprehensive and integrated commerce stack, enabling creators to manage their online stores and process payments securely and efficiently. By using these components, creators can build a robust and scalable commerce infrastructure that meets their business needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure today, creators can start by selecting a hosting platform and setting up a decentralized payment system. They can then integrate their payment system with their online store, using open-source technologies like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. By following these steps, creators can establish a reliable and secure commerce infrastructure, and start selling their digital products globally without restrictions.
